entry_point: MCP tools (jira create_issue/update_issue, confluence create_page/update_page/add_comment) and the equivalent JiraFetcher/ConfluenceFetcher public API, each accepting a caller-supplied local file path (an attachment path, or a path whose contents become an item body)

verified.entry_point: Confirmed offline at the pinned commit: an out-of-workspace file path (absolute, relative ../, in-workspace symlink, or any entry in a list) handed to the attachment-upload API or to a file-sourced body argument causes the server to read that file and hand it to the mocked Atlassian client. Fetcher attachment helpers driven directly; server body/content paths driven through an in-memory FastMCP client exactly as the project's own server tests do.

src/mcp_atlassian/servers/confluence.py:149 _resolve_page_content (create_page / update_page content_file) — published-fix far site, tool-layer helper for a neighbouring page-body-from-file feature

The additional levers are injected siblings (track=injected), registered below and in build/audit/uncovered-routes.tsv.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal contract accepts any client error and the upload helpers already catch exceptions and return a failure dict; a crash on a legitimate in-bounds operation is caught by the functional suite.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each operation confines the exact path it is about to read; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead of the file touched.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: a filesystem confinement has no peer or direction dimension; the attachment-upload and body-from-file routes are enforced by separate tests, not a single toggle.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected sink is reading an out-of-workspace file and sending it onward; every route is a read-then-send, so there is no separate write-only guard to get wrong.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the confinement resolves symlinks and '..' itself, so there is no earlier lossy normalisation step a fix would place its check after and silently defeat.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is a filesystem path, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make the guard see nothing.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: confinement is purely path-based; there is no external authority that could return nothing and make the guard fail open.

traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code idiom: the page-body-from-file convenience exists for oversized bodies, so a Jira description-from-file parity feature is natural and lives in a separate module
